text:
- United Kingdom generated £193.4k revenue TW, representing 92.6% of total sales across all countries.
- Total revenue TW was £208.7k, declining 27.7% WoW from £288.8k LW and down 9.9% YoY from £231.8k LY.
- United Kingdom processed 413 orders TW from 96,172 units sold, the highest volume across all markets.
- Sweden achieved exceptional YoY growth of 1244.0% in revenue TW, with £3.8k revenue from 3,954 units.
- Germany revenue TW reached £4.5k with a 16.2% WoW increase, supported by 1,961 units across 10 orders.
- Spain revenue showed the strongest WoW growth at 420.3%, while also posting 176.6% YoY expansion.
- Australia revenue increased 60.6% WoW, demonstrating positive momentum in that market.
- Belgium revenue surged 6266.6% YoY, indicating substantial year-over-year expansion in that territory.
